_comment: The twin of unverified-vendor-source, and the ONLY fixture that reaches a `verified` outcome. Same declaration, but the network map serves the upstream URL the packaged bytes themselves (sameAs), and the npm downloads endpoint a figure above the popularity bar - so verifyUrl returns 'verified' and the file is genuinely exempt: nothing reviews lib/widget.min.js. That is the whole point of the vendor system and it had no end-to-end coverage, because the harness could only ever make a fetch fail. The proof is the contrast: its twin declares the same pinned source, cannot verify it, and rejects the file via untrusted-minified-library. A minified file is exempt here ONLY because its bytes are that library's.
